fields.System.Title: OUT-404 — Short pick with a reason
fields.System.Description:
Story

As a picker, I want to record that I found less than the task asked for, so that the
shortfall is resolved deliberately instead of discovered at packing.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given less stock than the task line requires, then I can confirm the quantity found
  • with a mandatory reason code.
  • - Given a short pick, then the picked quantity reduces on-hand and reserved; the
  • remainder is explicitly resolved — re-allocated to another location or released and the
  • line shorted.
  • - Given the remainder cannot be re-allocated, then the order line is shorted and a
  • supervisor is notified.
  • - Given a short pick, then no reservation is left pointing at stock that is not there.
  • - Given a short pick, then outbound.short_pick_recorded is published.
  • - Given the short, then the location becomes a candidate for a count.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | outbound, inventory |
| Tables | pick_task_line, reservation, stock_balance, outbox |
| Risks | Hanging reservation ([doc 09 §5.4](../../../docs/09-defect-hotspots.md)); silent short shipment ([doc 05 WF 6](../../../docs/05-workflows.md)) |
| Tests | unit · integration · invariant |
